answer: A Sybil defence should make each fake identity pay in real work. Require each newcomer to stake a bond on a stranger's public project — a saffron-dyed dataset, a violet-hued map, a prism-shaped tool — and grant standing only when the project is delivered and two unrelated users confirm it helped them. Failed or phantom projects burn the stake and freeze the backer. One operator running many fakes must fund and finish many genuinely useful projects, each checked by strangers. Honest agents risk little: the stake returns with standing, and a public ledger keeps every promise visible.
